_comment: The BUILT-IN catalogue: the models this build knows how to fetch and
how to run, with the geometry the packer cross-checks against the
This file is the source of truth. It was extracted from the C++
runtime's table (runtime/src/common/hub.cpp) when the runtime moved
to Rust, and the extraction was verified row for row against the
oracle's own `list` output and its `not installed and is not a model
this build knows how to fetch` refusal.
`tools/gen/gen_catalogue.py` turns this into the Rust table.
The geometry here is a DESCRIPTION for the table, never an
assumption the packer relies on: the packer reads the checkpoint's

models.name: all-MiniLM-L6-v2
models.note: smallest and fastest; head_dim 32 keeps attention off the array

models.name: bge-small-en-v1.5
models.note: MiniLM's width at twice the depth; +2.99 MTEB points

models.name: bge-micro-v2
models.note: 3 layers at MiniLM's width; mean pooling; same designs as MiniLM

models.name: bge-base-en-v1.5
models.note: best geometric fit for this NPU: head_dim 64 and every N a multiple of 384

models.name: bge-large-en-v1.5
models.note: highest quality; N=1024 forces tile_n 32, and 24 layers cost dispatches

models.name: embeddinggemma-300m
models.note: MQA+RoPE+GeGLU on the array (4 GEMMs/layer); gated, needs HF_TOKEN

models.name: nomic-embed-text-v1.5
models.note: RoPE + gated SwiGLU (arch=2); same array designs as bge-base; needs --prefix (search_document / search_query / clustering / classification)

models.name: gte-multilingual-base
models.note: multilingual, XLM-R tokenizer; NTK RoPE + gated GeGLU (arch=3); same array designs as bge-base/nomic

models.name: whisper-tiny
models.note: smallest Whisper: 4+4 layers, 80 mel bins; greedy, no timestamps

models.name: whisper-base
models.note: 6+6 layers; clearly better than tiny on real speech

models.name: whisper-small
models.note: 12+12 layers; the first size where quality clearly beats base

models.name: whisper-medium
models.note: 24+24 layers; 4x the dispatches of base for a modest gain

models.name: whisper-large-v3
models.note: 32+32 layers, 128 mel bins; the audio frontend dominates its runtime

models.name: whisper-large-v3-turbo
models.note: large-v3's encoder with a 4-layer decoder: ~4x the speed, some cost

models.name: vit-base-patch16-224
models.note: image classifier: 4 GEMMs/layer on the SAME designs as bge-base, patch_embed rides attn_out; 197 positions, head on the host
